name: Transom
author: Cody Williams
description: A Windows-style taskbar for Omarchy: start button, quick launch, this workspace's windows, tray, show desktop.

barWidget.description: Optional: show or hide the taskbar, and its main settings, from the top bar. The taskbar works without it.

schema.label: Show icon
schema.description: Off, the widget takes no room on the bar but Transom keeps running. Removing the widget instead can turn Transom off (see the README).
